reading.zh: 文件进来先过校验（格式/版本/步骤类型），再由执行器逐步编译成命令交给同一个派发；没有命令行等价物的步骤（sleep、wait-window）由执行器自己处理。
reading.en: A file is validated first (format, version, step types), then the runner compiles each step into a command for the shared dispatch; steps without a command-line equivalent (sleep, wait-window) are handled by the runner itself.
